note: Corrections for text damaged at write time. `old` is copied byte-for-byte from the pre-repair database, so a drift stops the apply tool instead of overwriting silently. "high" = one mechanism explains both the damage and the repair (corpus string, transliteration pattern, keystroke map). "medium"/"low" = a defensible reading rather than a recovery, flagged needs_human so a Nepali reader can overrule it. Records are idempotent: a row already holding `new` counts as applied.

corrections.evidence: gloss_en is 'to pour liquid' (浇 jiao). Stored value is U+FFFD + लनु, so the leading syllable is unrecoverable; no completion of '?लनु' is a pouring verb (फैलनु spreads, उम्लनु boils). खन्याउनु is the standard Nepali verb for pouring a liquid. The corpus carries no pouring verb at all (खन्याउ/पोख returned only पोखरी pond), so this is the one row that a Nepali reader should still confirm.

gloss_en 'to encourage' (鼓励). Stored 'U+FFFD + त्साहित गर्नु'. Both उत्साहित गर्नु and प्रोत्साहित गर्नु are grammatical; उत्साहित गर्नु exists verbatim in the shipped corpus (sense 12575, 促使) and is the single-character completion, so the minimal-edit hypothesis wins. The alternative is recorded here for review.

gloss_en 'surname Shuai' (帅 shuai). Stored 'शuai उपनाम': Latin 'uai' typed inside a Devanagari word. The corpus transliterates surnames with Devanagari vowels in the same slots: 'surname Xiu' -> शिउ उपनाम, 'surname Yuan' -> युआन उपनाम, so uai -> ुआइ.

gloss_en 'no wonder!' (怪不得). Stored 'केही आश्चर्य नै हoinu': the five Latin letters h-o-i-n-u sit exactly where होइन belongs, and होइन is the standard negated copula. The corpus also carries अचम्म छैन for "(it's) no wonder (that...)".
gloss_en 'lamp' (灯 deng). Stored 'बatti' = Devanagari ब followed by Latin atti; 'batti' transliterates बत्ती, and the corpus already contains मोमबत्ती for candle.

gloss_en 'lantern' (灯笼). Same stored bytes as 112935, i.e. one typed word reused. बत्ती covers a lantern as a light; a stricter form would be लल्टिन, which the corpus does not carry, so the minimal repair keeps बत्ती and is flagged for semantic review.

gloss_en 'to pursue (a goal etc) stubbornly' (追求). Stored 'दृढतापूर्वक пурсnu' mixes Cyrillic п/у/р with Latin s/n/u, i.e. the English word 'pursue' half-typed. The corpus Nepali for following/pursuing is पछ्याउनु ('to follow'), so the phrase is rebuilt from project vocabulary rather than invented.
